messages:
tasha: Huge thanks to @intern-lee for spotting the muted mic 2 minutes before the customer Q&A. also shoutout to @security-team for fast auth help when the SSO flaked :clap:
devin: yesss. Lee literally shouted 'mic' from the back and saved the applause moment. we owe you a sugar medal. :medal:
mike: and @sara for keeping the chat calm and fielding the questions while we sorted audio. smooth triage. :100:
intern-lee: wow thanks! first big save. i practice saying 'mic check' in the mirror apparently. :grimacing:
security-team: quick note: we saw a transient SSO token refresh failure during the demo window. resolved with a grace-period tweak and cleared cache. filing a short postmortem for the runbook. :lock:
sara: can we add a 1-line mic checklist to the demo runbook? eg: mic on, camera angle, SSO ok. saves future panic. :memo:
tasha: great idea. @events-team can you add laminated 'mic, camera, SSO' cards to the podium? maybe with a tiny mascot sticker so people actually look at it. :sparkles:
events-team: On it. We'll print 10 cards and put them in the A/V drawer. Also thinking of a small 'celebration' poll: cake or cookies for the rescue crew? :cake: :cookie:
Devin: poll: cake
Mike: poll: cookies
Sara: poll: cake
Intern-lee: poll: cookies
Tasha: cake wins (narrow margin). cupcakes tomorrow 3pm in kitchen A. thanks everyone — cross-team saves like this are the best. :heart:
